correctness.rationale: Six primitive unimodular corner charts cover Y and give the same monomial coordinates; exact universal Hasse-Taylor matrix reduces to block diagonal I3 and B. B has determinant zero identically, 2-minor ideal (ab) in char2 and (a,b)^2 otherwise, and entry ideal (a,b) always. These are local defining ideals on all charts, proving ranks, reducedness and length 18. Included self-contained verifier executes exact polynomial checks; finite samples are ancillary.

value.rationale: The Togliatti surface is a classical natural osculatory test object. The nontrivial scheme multiplicity (six local length-three neighborhoods) and exceptional characteristic-two jump to the reduced anticanonical hexagon show structural specialization failure invisible from classical set-theoretic rank data. The next degeneracy rank stratum remaining reduced is an informative boundary. The statement is exact and independent of arbitrary parameter choices.
